subject: science
domain: From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes

items.prompt:
Which of these is an environmental factor that affects growth?
A) Inherited genes
B) Amount of sunlight
C) Chromosome number
D) DNA sequence

steps: Sunlight is a condition in the environment that affects growth.

items.prompt:
Instructions inherited from an organism's parents are called:
A) Environmental factors
B) Genetic factors
C) Nutrients
D) Temperatures

Which pair are both environmental factors for a plant?
A) Genes and DNA
B) Water and sunlight
C) Chromosomes and genes
D) Instinct and heredity

steps: Water and sunlight are conditions in the environment.

items.prompt:
Two plants have identical genes. One grows tall in sunlight; one stays short in the shade. The difference is caused by:
A) Genetic factors
B) Environmental factors
C) Neither factor
D) A mutation

steps: With the same genes, the difference must come from the environment.

items.prompt:
A puppy fed a poor diet stays smaller than typical for its breed. This shows that growth depends on:
A) Genes only
B) The environment as well as genes
C) Nothing at all
D) Only the breed name
items.answer: B) The environment as well as genes

steps: Poor diet (environment) limited growth, so environment matters along with genes.

items.prompt:
Which statement is correct?
A) Only genes affect growth
B) Only the environment affects growth
C) Both genes and the environment affect growth
D) Neither affects growth
items.answer: C) Both genes and the environment affect growth

steps: Growth results from genetic and environmental factors acting together.

items.prompt:
A scientist wants to test whether fertilizer affects plant growth. Which setup is best?
A) Give two plants different genes and different light
B) Give two identical plants the same conditions except one gets fertilizer
C) Give one plant everything and ignore the other
D) Change many things at once
items.answer: B) Give two identical plants the same conditions except one gets fertilizer

steps: Keeping everything the same except fertilizer isolates its effect.

items.prompt:
A plant with genes for great height grows poorly in dry, dark conditions. Best explanation?
A) Its genes changed
B) The environment limited the growth its genes allow
C) Genes do not affect height
D) The plant has no genes
items.answer: B) The environment limited the growth its genes allow

steps: Genes set a potential, but poor environmental conditions limited the growth reached.
